nb2_lite_1K.texto: A distant figure hangs from the thick branch of a lone dead tree at the edge of a frontier town, seen in silhouette against the dawn sky, the rope a thin dark line, the body turning slightly in the wind. In the foreground, a small crowd of townspeople in long coats and wide-brimmed hats stands in silence with their backs to the camera, a horse-drawn wagon stopped on the dirt road beside them. Men and women of European descent with fair skin and weathered faces. Dusty frontier settlement 1893, timber storefronts, a dirt main road, dry scrubland beyond. Cold blue pre-dawn light with a thin orange line on the horizon, long soft shadows. Wide shot, eye-level, 50mm lens, deep depth of field. A grainy 35mm documentary photograph taken in 1893, with muted colors and slight underexposure, in a dark-history realist style. The image has a 16:9 aspect ratio. No readable text, no signage, no labels.
